name: monday
description: Connect monday.com to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use monday.com MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect monday.com to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with boards, items and updates using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my monday.com workspace.
Find anything in monday.com that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review boards, items and updates in monday.com.
